questions.q: The power required to deliver a given quantity of fluid against a given head with no losses in the pump is called:
Fluids that are pumped in processing work are frequently more viscous than water. Which of the following statements is correct?
options: Reynolds number varies directly as the viscosity
Efficiency of a pump increases as the viscosity increases
Increased fluid friction between the pump parts and the passing fluid decreases useful work
Working head increases as the viscosity
questions.answer: Increased fluid friction between the pump parts and the passing fluid decreases useful work
